artifact.creation_path: ml/train.py → ml/evaluate.py; never loaded from an upload

calibration: uncalibrated — no calibration test has been run

classes.0: predicted non-default next month (not a guarantee of payment)
classes.1: predicted default next month (not a confirmed delinquency)

selection.objective: Maximise mean 5-fold cross-validated F1 on class 1 (default next month) on the training rows only. F1 is the primary objective because 77.88% of the sample is class 0, so accuracy is dominated by the majority class; F1 balances default-class recall against the false-positive cost that precision charges for. Ties within 0.005 absolute CV F1 are broken by higher mean CV recall, then higher mean CV precision. A candidate whose mean CV F1 is not above zero is ineligible. The held-out test set plays no part in this choice.

model.threshold_note: fixed at the evaluated value; an alternative threshold needs train/validation-only selection and its own evaluation evidence
model.transform: passthrough (a tree splits on order, not distance)

probability_label: Estimated model probability of next-month default
